title: Publish articles
description: Write and publish articles on your public artist page.

blocks.content: Articles are long-form posts on your artist page — news, stories, photo galleries, and more. Manage them under **Dashboard → Posts** (shown as **Posts** in English, **Статьи** in Russian).

blocks.subtitle: Create an article
content: Add a title, cover image, and content blocks.
Save as draft or publish when ready.

blocks.subtitle: Visibility
content: **Public** — visible to everyone on your artist page.
**Subscribers only** — requires the listener to add you to their Premium collection.
**Hidden** — not shown on the public site.

blocks.subtitle: Public URLs
content: Published articles appear under `/{language}/articles` on the platform and on your artist hub.
Your email must be verified to publish articles.
